name: Wrong measurement
about: A number in the report is wrong or misleading

<!--
This is the highest-value bug in the repo. A trainer that measures you wrongly is
worse than no trainer, so thank you for taking the time.

Fill in what you can — "the talk ratio felt way off, I don't have the numbers any
more" is still worth opening.
-->

**Which metric**
e.g. silent coding, talk ratio, planning window

**What it showed**

**What actually happened in the session**
Roughly when did you speak, and when were you typing? A rough recollection is fine.

**Session length**

**Anything unusual about the recording**
Background noise, a very quiet mic, long pauses, another person talking?
